recommendation: Use hand.R or hand.L as wrist parent; derive an estimated palm attachment midpoint between wrist and identified finger roots; preserve mount rotation; allow manual correction. No new skeleton bone.

snapshot_runtime.limits: A saved real-character snapshot, not visual verification

failure_behavior: Reject nonhand, missing/ambiguous finger roots, invalid mount or unfinished fitting. Restore prior mount pose and calibration flag on failure. New mount removed on failure. Multiple mounts require explicit selection.
boundaries: Current pose is an estimate. Does not automatically align weapon grip geometry, animate wrist/fingers, or copy reference weapon motion. Native UNDO declared; interactive undo/redo NotRun.
future_changes: different finger names are checked locally and fail with a prompt when ambiguous
a second user-selected mount is reused without changing ownership
additional body parts stay on existing behavior
cleanup: No temporary production diagnostics added. Existing isolated scene snapshot and test evidence retained until user review.
